mapper.insert: insert into receipt (receipt_id, user_id, object_key, bucket_name, file_url, file_name, content_type, file_size, status, total_amount, created_at, updated_at, reference_id ) values (#{receiptId,jdbcType=OTHER}, #{userId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{objectKey,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bucketName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileUrl,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileSize,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{totalAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{createdAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{updatedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{referenceId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT receipt_id, user_id, object_key, bucket_name, file_url, file_name, content_type, file_size, status, total_amount, created_at, updated_at, reference_id FROM receipt WHERE receipt_id = #{receiptId}::uuid
